d: Days after Republicans lost both the House and Senate, reports have emerged that Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth and Secretary of State Marco Rubio could both be leaving the Trump administration. The White House has denied both reports. Hegseth is also facing a fresh impeachment push from Republican Congressman Thomas Massie, who plans to reintroduce eight articles of impeachment next week. Meanwhile, Vice President JD Vance publicly blamed the Iran war for the Republican defeat — breaking with Trump's official line.
